channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 20 Aug: Harare clear sky · high 23° / low 10°
item.description: Harare: high 23°, low 10° (clear sky) · Bulawayo: high 26°, low 10° (clear sky) · Mutare: high 23°, low 12° (overcast) · Gweru: high 25°, low 10° (clear sky) · Masvingo: high 26°, low 10° (clear sky) · Victoria Falls: high 28°, low 12° (clear sky) Tsumo yezuva: Chisi hachieri chisingabudi rimwe.
